is_anopheles.evidence: The study was conducted exclusively on Culex quinquefasciatus: 'We used Culex quinquefasciatus as a model mosquito examined the insecticide resistance mechanisms of mosquitoes to PBO-synergized pyrethroid' (lines 20-21, page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Although L1014F kdr mutation is assayed (line 31-32, page 2; line 210, page 11), it is tested only in Culex quinquefasciatus, not in any Anopheles species.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Genotype/allele counts or sample sizes per genotype are not clearly reported; only an overall mutation rate (61.8%) from pooled mosquitoes is mentioned (lines 212-213, page 11; line 293, page 15) for Culex.

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes were collected in Southern California, USA: 'Field Cx. quinquefasciatus (OC-R strain) larvae were collected from multiple places in Irvine, Garden Grove and Orange cities of Orange County, Southern California' (lines 147-148, page 9).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a primary research study evaluating bioassays and enzyme expressions in Culex mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Locations provided include 'Irvine, Garden Grove and Orange cities of Orange County, Southern California' (lines 147-148, page 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years are not specified in the manuscript text.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original laboratory study using field collections from Orange County, California.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary tables S1 and S2 are present at the end of the document, but the study is not about Anopheles.

assessment.summary: This study examines the mechanisms of resistance to PBO-synergized pyrethroids in Culex quinquefasciatus collected from Orange County, California. It does not investigate African Anopheles vector populations.
exclusion_reasons: Study does not focus on Anopheles mosquitoes (performed on Culex quinquefasciatus).
No target resistance markers evaluated in Anopheles malaria vectors.
Mosquito samples are not from an African field population (collected in California, USA).
